verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a documented public API built on the open JMAP standard. It covers session discovery, OAuth or bearer API tokens, batched query/fetch/send calls, push via EventSource or WebPush, and efficient sync, so core mail operations are programmable. Nothing in the evidence shows that UI features such as filters and rules, masked email, snooze, scheduled send, templates, aliases or account settings are reachable through the API, so UI parity is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for filters/rules, masked email, aliases, settings, snooze/scheduled send and templates; an explicit statement of API–UI parity; independent hands-on corroboration.
